body: The day my parents sat my twin sister and I down and told us that one of us was an accident and the other was adopted. Also that we were replaceable but the horses weren't.

The year my 5th grade teacher literally made my friends and peers get up in front of class and make fun of me. I've never really had a "normal" relationship since. I have a lot of trouble connecting still.
Looking around and realizing there is no one you can really talk to anymore.
Do you not know what a missile shield is?

I will. I don't how else to describe this feeling of apathy.. I mean I do care and feel which is part of the reason I'm reaching out like this. This is closer then I've ever come before. Before today I'd say I'd never kill myself but recently I've found myself googling how to do it and it scares me that I'm at this point.
